- Left: crash at col 11 (boat hits structure at col 8)
- Right: unknown
- Top: crash at row 12 (boat hits something)
- Bottom: crash at row 44 (boat hits something)

- Rows: 14-42 (approximately)
- Cols: 13-51 (approximately)
The small boats are at:
1. [[11, 35], [11, 38], [12, 37], [12, 36]] - row 11-12, col 35-38 (TOP - outside playable area?)
2. [[15, 19], [15, 22], [16, 21], [16, 20]] - row 15-16, col 19-22 (TOP-LEFT - inside playable area)
3. [[34, 42], [34, 45], [35, 44], [35, 43]] - row 34-35, col 42-45 (BOTTOM-RIGHT - inside playable area)
4. [[35, 20], [35, 23], [36, 22], [36, 21]] - row 35-36, col 20-23 (BOTTOM-LEFT - inside playable area)
The small boat at [[11, 35], [11, 38], [12, 37], [12, 36]] is at row 11-12, which is near the top boundary (crash at row 12). So maybe the player can't reach it directly.
The other small boats are within the playable area. Let me try to reach one of them.
The small boat at [[15, 19], [15, 22], [16, 21], [16, 20]] is at row 15-16, col 19-22. The player is at (26, 31). I need to go UP 5-6 (10-12 rows) and LEFT 5-6 (10-12 cols).
But I crashed at row 12 (UP 7 from row 26). So I can go UP 5 (10 rows) to reach row 16, which is safe. Then LEFT 5 (10 cols) to reach col 21.
Wait, but I also crashed at col 11 (LEFT too far). The small boat is at col 19-22, which is well within the left boundary. So I should be able to reach it.
Let me try: UP 5, LEFT 5. This should put the player at row 16, col 21, which is near the small boat at [[15, 19], [15, 22], [16, 21], [16, 20]].
But wait, the boat might collide with the small boat. The player's boat, when the player is at row 16, col 21, would be centered at row 18, col 19. The boat spans rows 17-19, cols 15-22. The small boat is at rows 15-16, cols 19-22. There's no overlap in rows (17-19 vs 15-16). So the boat shouldn't collide with the small boat.
Let me try this.

<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Game reset. Player at (26, 31).
# Boundaries:
# - Left: crash at col 11
# - Right: unknown
# - Top: crash at row 12
# - Bottom: crash at row 44

# Playable area: rows 14-42, cols 13-51 (approx)
# Small boats within playable area:
# - [[15, 19], [15, 22], [16, 21], [16, 20]] - row 15-16, col 19-22
# - [[34, 42], [34, 45], [35, 44], [35, 43]] - row 34-35, col 42-45
# - [[35, 20], [35, 23], [36, 22], [36, 21]] - row 35-36, col 20-23

# Let me try to reach the small boat at [[15, 19], [15, 22], [16, 21], [16, 20]]
# Target: row 16, col 21
# Current: row 26, col 31
# Need: UP 5 (10 rows), LEFT 5 (10 cols)

# Navigate UP 5, LEFT 5
result = action(['UP'] * 5 + ['LEFT'] * 5)
seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
player = [n for n in seg if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] == 1]
print(f"Player: {[(n['boundary']) for n in player]}")
print(f"Game over: {result.get('game_over', False)}")

if not result.get('game_over', False):
    # Check proximity to small boat
    small_boats = [n for n in seg if n['color'] == 'S' and n['pixels'] == 6]
    print(f"\nSmall boats:")
    for sb in small_boats:
        print(f"  boundary={sb['boundary']}")
    
    # Check adjacency
    adj = current_frame.segmentation['adjacency_list']
    player_id = [n['id'] for n in seg if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] == 1][0]
    player_adj = [j if i == player_id else i for i, j in adj if player_id in [i, j]]
    print(f"\nPlayer adjacents: {player_adj}")
    
    # Check what's adjacent to the player
    for adj_id in player_adj:
        adj_node = seg[adj_id]
        print(f"  Adjacent: color={adj_node['color']}, pixels={adj_node['pixels']}, boundary={adj_node['boundary']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
